0022600136.text: The Toronto Raptors, who are 2-1 and playing at home in their fourth game of the 2026-27 season, sit 3rd in the Atlantic and 5th in the East after a loss in their most recent game, while the Orlando Magic are 1-2, 10th in the East, and coming off a win. The Raptors lead the season series 2-1 from 2025-26, and they beat Orlando 139-87 in Toronto on March 29, 2026, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Paolo Banchero, and Anthony Black is day-to-day with a personal reason and is a game-time decision.
